meta.name: detecting-api-enumeration-attacks
meta.description: Detect and prevent API enumeration attacks including BOLA and IDOR exploitation by monitoring sequential identifier access patterns and authorization failures.

copy.tagline: 检测并阻止API枚举攻击，保护数据安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的API面临枚举攻击风险
copy.tagline_en: Detect and prevent API enumeration attacks to protect your data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your API is at risk of enumeration attacks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 API 访问日志，检测出枚举攻击（如 BOLA/IDOR）的模式，并生成告警信息。
howto.when: 当用户提供 API 访问日志或询问如何检测 API 枚举攻击时触发。

say.text: 分析这段API日志，找出可能的BOLA枚举攻击。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键指标并判断是否存在攻击。

say.text: 用Splunk查询检测小于5分钟内访问超过20个唯一ID的IP。
say.note: Claude 会给出对应的搜索语句。

say.text: 运行Python脚本检测顺序ID枚举。
say.note: Claude 会指导如何使用内置脚本分析日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze API access logs, detect enumeration attack patterns (e.g., BOLA/IDOR), and generate alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users provide API access logs or ask about detecting API enumeration attacks.

say_en.text: Analyze this API log for possible BOLA enumeration attacks.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key indicators and assess if an attack exists.

say_en.text: Query Splunk to detect IPs accessing more than 20 unique IDs in under 5 minutes.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the corresponding search query.

say_en.text: Run the Python script to detect sequential ID enumeration.
say_en.note: Claude will guide usage of the built-in script to analyze logs.
